text: @moazzamak/dsh-code-review 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的插件。它注册 /review 命令，在右侧栏打开最近一轮已记录改动的逐文件比较，并在适用时隐藏对话中的内置改动卡片；同时注册 dsh-change-review Skill，向 agent 说明审阅记录覆盖范围和如何组织便于审阅的改动。适合希望快速查看某轮文件变化并让 agent 理解审阅方式的 DSH 用户。安装需要包含对应比较视图和会话服务的 DSH 0.2 及以上版本，不需要额外密钥或外部账号。

@moazzamak/dsh-code-review adds /review to DSH's web client, opening the newest turn's per-file comparison in the sidebar. It can hide the built-in change card and registers a Skill explaining review coverage and how to make changes easier to review. Requires DSH 0.2 or later; no API key is needed.
我想一键查看最近一轮都改了哪些文件。
能在 DSH 右侧栏打开每轮改动的逐文件对比吗？
让 DSH 提供一个命令来审阅最新会话改动。
我希望 agent 知道每轮改动审阅记录包含什么。
Show me the files changed in the latest DSH turn, one by one.
Can I open a session's newest change comparison in the sidebar?
Give the agent guidance on what a turn-by-turn review record includes.
@moazzamak/dsh-code-review 的功能「打开最新改动」：通过 /review 在右侧栏打开当前会话最新一轮已记录改动的逐文件对比；命令仅在视图、侧栏和改动记录可用时显示。
@moazzamak/dsh-code-review 的功能「协调内置改动卡片」：对有改动记录且没有已声明展示文件的回合，插件通过 turn-tail 插槽隐藏内置改动卡片；存在展示文件时保留原卡片。
@moazzamak/dsh-code-review 的功能「提供审阅 Skill」：插件运行时注册 dsh-change-review，向 agent 说明按回合记录改动的范围、限制及便于用户审阅的写作方式。
@moazzamak/dsh-code-review 使用前须知：需要 DSH 提供会话事件、右侧栏比较视图及相关客户端服务；插件以可选 peer 依赖声明这些集成，兼容性依赖宿主实现。
想让审阅入口只在确实有本轮改动可看时出现。

@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · Which dsh this drives：DeepSeek Harness replaced its review surface in the 0.2 line, and this pack follows it.

| Pack | dsh | What `/review` opens |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0.2.x | 0.2 and later | The selected turn's **changed files**, each with a side-by-side or unified comparison. There is no keep/reject step. |
| 0.1.x | 0.1.5 | The pinned **Changes** page, with per-chunk Keep/Reject that reverted a rejected chunk in the working tree. |

@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · Which dsh this drives：dsh 0.2 removed the keep/reject surface entirely: nothing reverts a change behind the agent's back any more, no rejection is reported back to the model, and the diff record is read-only. The 0.2 Skill says so, because an agent told to expect a rejection note would wait for one that never arrives. Use 0.1.x only on a dsh 0.1.5 build.

@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:moazzamak/dsh-code-review
```

Restart `dsh` (or reload the page) afterwards. To remove it again:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @moazzamak/dsh-code-review
```

Once installed, three things appear: a **Plugins** entry in Settings, `/review` in the input, and `dsh-change-review` in the agent's Skill list.

@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · Desktop app：The Electron desktop build runs the same dsh surfaces, so the comparison view is there without any plugin. Adding *this pack* to a packaged desktop app is a separate step: the app's **Desktop Plugins** window installs plugins into its own profile with its bundled pnpm, and it accepts npm registry specs only. Add the bundle to that profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` list, or install it from a local checkout.

@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · What you get：The recording, the comparison, and the turn-tail card are part of dsh itself. This pack adds the shortcut, the instructions, and the precedence, nothing else.

@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · Precedence：`/review` opens dsh's own per-file comparison; it is the built-in diff view, reached by shortcut. So "the pack takes precedence" cannot mean a different viewer — it means dsh stops offering its **second** way in. That second way is the changed-files card dsh draws under each completed turn, whose header opens the same comparison.

@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · Precedence：While the pack is installed, that card is suppressed: the transcript goes back to prose plus tool rows, and the diff surface lives in the right sidebar, where `/review` puts it.

Two limits are deliberate.

@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · Precedence：- **A turn that declared files with the `present` tool keeps the built-in card.** The card and the declared-file rows are drawn by one component, and this pack has no substitute for the rows, so suppressing the card there would delete the rows with it. The pack claims a turn only while the card is the only thing that component would draw.
- **Precedence is the pack's, not a preference.** There is nothing to switch on and no setting it reads or changes; removing the pack restores the card.

@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · Precedence：The pack does not read or change **Show coding view** (`developerTools`) — the setting described under [The turn-tail card](#the-turn-tail-card) — and turning that setting off still removes the card the ordinary way, whether or not this pack is installed.

@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · Reviewing changes：1. Run `/review`.
2. The sidebar lists the newest turn's changed files, each with its added and removed line counts.
3. Pick a file. Its comparison opens on the first changed file of the turn; **split**/**unified** and **line wrap** are controls on the view.
4. A file whose contents are unchanged at the turn's end is not listed at all, and a file larger than the recorder's limit is listed without a comparison.

@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · The turn-tail card：By default dsh also draws a changed-files card under each turn in the conversation, and each card carries a **Review this turn's changes in the sidebar** action. Both are gated by one setting, **Show coding view** (`developerTools`), which also controls the Trajectory view and the full Agent preset picker.

@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · The turn-tail card：Installing this pack suppresses the card without touching that setting — see [Precedence](#precedence). Turning the setting off still works the ordinary way and removes the card whether or not the pack is installed.
@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · Requirements：The pack drives dsh's own review surface, so it needs a dsh build that includes it:

@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · Requirements：| What it uses | Package |
| --- | --- |
| The comparison view and the `changes-review` tab kind | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deliverables` |
| The closing-turn chain the built-in diff card is contributed to | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat` |
| The slot renderer the suppression contributes through | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer` |
| `openResource`, and the mounted-Session snapshot | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right` |
| The Session's loaded event window (`sessions.binding`) | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` |
| The `workspace/changes` event that names each recorded turn | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace-changes` |
| A Skill registry | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` |

@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · Requirements：The tab kind, the chain key, the event, and the address format it opens are private to those packages, so this pack restates them in one module (`src/protocol.ts`) and pins each restated fact with a test. A dsh build that renames the kind, the chain, the event, or the address fails that test rather than silently breaking `/review` — or silently losing the precedence, which would put the card back without anyone noticing.
@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · Requirements：Every dsh package is declared as an optional peer, so installing the pack never pulls a second copy of dsh.

@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · Naming and affiliation：Unofficial and community-built: not affiliated with, endorsed by, or published by DeepSeek. The review surface this pack drives is DeepSeek Harness's own code, MIT-licensed like this pack, and lives at [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — problems with dsh itself belong there.

@moazzamak/dsh-code-review README · Naming and affiliation：Similar names exist on npm. These are unrelated packages by other authors: `dsh-code-review` (a read-only review agent preset), `@moazzamak/dsh-code-review`, `@moazzamak/dsh-code-review` (change summaries, a review tab, and guarded undo), and `@moazzamak/dsh-code-review` (a two-column git-diff page). This pack is **`@moazzamak/dsh-code-review`**, published only from [this repository](https://github.com/moazzamak/dsh-code-review).
